tricks.name: Bunny Hop
tricks.description: Hop the front wheel, then the rear, to clear obstacles and gaps cleanly.

tricks.name: Manual
tricks.description: Lift the front wheel and balance on the rear without pedaling for as long as you can.

tricks.name: Wheelie
tricks.description: Balance on the rear wheel while pedaling and ride it out with control.

tricks.name: Endo
tricks.description: Apply the front brake, lift the rear wheel, and hold the endo before rolling off.

tricks.name: Footjam
tricks.description: Jam the front foot between the tire and fork to stop the bike and hold the pivot.

tricks.name: Fakie
tricks.description: Ride backward after a half turn and roll away without touching a foot down.

tricks.name: X-Up
tricks.description: Spin the bars 180 mid-air and snap them back before landing.

tricks.name: Barspin
tricks.description: Spin the handlebars a full 360 while airborne and catch them clean.

tricks.name: Tabletop
tricks.description: Lay the bike flat over the obstacle mid-air and pull it back for the landing.

tricks.name: One Footer
tricks.description: Kick one foot off the pedal mid-air and bring it back before touching down.

tricks.name: No Hander
tricks.description: Take both hands off the bars mid-air and grab them again before landing.
Spin a half turn with the bike and land rolling away in the opposite direction.

tricks.name: Drop In
tricks.description: Roll from the coping straight down the ramp and commit to the drop.

tricks.name: Kickturn
tricks.description: Lift the front wheel and pivot on the rear wheel to turn around in the transition.

tricks.name: Rock to Fakie
tricks.description: Ride up the wall, rock the front wheel over the coping, and roll back in fakie.

tricks.name: Double Peg Grind
tricks.description: Lock both pegs on the obstacle and ride the grind all the way to the end.

tricks.name: Feeble Grind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg with the rear wheel dropping off the far side of the rail.

tricks.name: Tire Tap
tricks.description: Ride up the ramp, tap the front tire on the coping, and roll back in fakie.
Rotate a full 360 with the bike and stomp the landing facing the same direction.

tricks.name: Tailwhip
tricks.description: Kick the rear of the bike around a full 360 under you and land with the rear wheel back.

tricks.name: No Footed Can
tricks.description: Kick both feet off the pedals mid-air and bring them back before the landing.

tricks.name: Tuck No Hander
tricks.description: Let go of the bars and tuck the arms close while flying over the jumps.

tricks.name: 180 Barspin
tricks.description: Spin a 180 while throwing the bars a full rotation and catch them clean.

tricks.name: Crank Flip
tricks.description: Spin the cranks a full 360 while airborne and land back on the pedals.

tricks.name: Turndown
tricks.description: Turn the bars and bike into a twisted position mid-air and return before landing.

tricks.name: Can Can
tricks.description: Kick one foot over the top tube and back across the bike mid-air.

tricks.name: Disaster
tricks.description: Stall both pegs on the coping and pivot back in without touching down.

tricks.name: Smith Grind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg on the obstacle with the rear wheel tucking behind the rail.

tricks.name: Crooked Grind
tricks.description: Lock the front peg and cross the rear of the bike over the obstacle at an angle.

tricks.name: Icepick Grind
tricks.description: Balance the rear peg on the edge and ride the icepick down the full ledge.

tricks.name: Superman Seat Grab
tricks.description: Push the bike out in front of you, grab the seat, and pull it back in.

tricks.name: Wallride
tricks.description: Ride up a wall, roll along it sideways, and drop back down with control.

tricks.name: Half Cab
tricks.description: Spin a 180 out of fakie and ride forward in your natural stance.

tricks.name: Alley Oop
tricks.description: Ride up the wall and spin the opposite way before dropping back in.

tricks.name: Nose Pick
tricks.description: Balance the front peg on the edge with the rear wheel lifted off the obstacle.

tricks.name: Smith Stall
tricks.description: Stall the front peg on the coping in the smith position and roll back in.

tricks.name: Feeble Stall
tricks.description: Stall the front peg on the coping and drop back into the ramp.

tricks.name: Nose Wheelie
tricks.description: Balance on the front wheel while pedaling and hold the nose wheelie.

tricks.name: Rock n Roll
tricks.description: Rock the front wheel over the coping and turn back in frontside.

tricks.name: Full Cab
tricks.description: Spin a 360 out of fakie and roll away forward in your natural stance.

tricks.name: Opposite Whip
tricks.description: Whip the rear end around the opposite way and pull it back before landing.

tricks.name: Downside Whip
tricks.description: Throw the whip on the downside of the lip and catch it back under you.

tricks.name: Double Whip
tricks.description: Kick the rear of the bike around two full spins and land square.

tricks.name: Candybar
tricks.description: Kick both feet over the top tube and back in one clean motion.

tricks.name: Toboggan
tricks.description: Lift both feet over the front of the bike and hold the toboggan through the air.

tricks.name: Truckdriver
tricks.description: Grab the seat and spin the whole bike a full rotation around you.

tricks.name: Superman
tricks.description: Push the bike out fully in front of you and pull it back before the landing.

tricks.name: Decade
tricks.description: Spin the bars and body 360 while keeping the bike straight beneath you.
Rotate a 540 above the lip and stomp the landing back in the ramp.
Rotate two full spins above the ramp and land clean on the transition.

tricks.name: Backflip
tricks.description: Rotate the whole bike backward over the lip and land back in the transition.

tricks.name: Frontflip
tricks.description: Rotate the whole bike forward mid-air and stomp the landing.

tricks.name: Flair
tricks.description: Combine a backflip with a 180 rotation and land the flair in the ramp.

tricks.name: Bike Flip
tricks.description: Flip the entire bike a full rotation while keeping your body in place.

tricks.name: Barspin to Tailwhip
tricks.description: Throw a barspin into a tailwhip and catch both before the landing.

tricks.name: 360 Barspin
tricks.description: Rotate a full 360 while spinning the bars a full rotation.

tricks.name: Fakie Tailwhip
tricks.description: Whip the rear of the bike 360 while riding fakie and land rolling forward.

tricks.name: Pedal Grind
tricks.description: Lock the pedals and crank on the rail and ride the pedal grind to the end.

tricks.name: Fufanu
tricks.description: Jam the foot into the wheel, spin the bike around the ledge, and ride out.

tricks.name: Footjam Tailwhip
tricks.description: Jam the front foot and spin the rear wheel around a full 360 before riding out.

tricks.name: Suicide No Hander
tricks.description: Take both hands off the bars and arch way back before pulling it in.

tricks.name: Kickflip
tricks.description: Flip the entire bike 360 around its axis with a flick of the feet.

tricks.name: 360 Tailwhip
tricks.description: Rotate a full 360 while kicking a tailwhip in the same motion.

tricks.name: Abubaca
tricks.description: Plant the rear peg on the coping and hold the abubaca above the ramp.
